## Summary
- Diagnostic Category: [`lint/nursery/noNestedSwitch`](/reference/diagnostics#diagnostic-category)
- This rule doesn't have a fix.
- The default severity of this rule is [**information**](/reference/diagnostics#information).
- Sources: 
  - Same as [`sonarjs/no-nested-switch`](https://github.com/SonarSource/eslint-plugin-sonarjs/blob/HEAD/docs/rules/no-nested-switch.md)

## How to configure
```json title="biome.json"
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"nursery": {
				"noNestedSwitch": "error"
			}
		}
	}
}

```
## Description
Disallow `switch` statements inside other `switch` statements.

A `switch` statement inside another `switch` statement is hard to read,
because it is easy to mix up which `case` belongs to which `switch`.
Move the inner `switch` into a separate function, written outside the
outer `switch`, instead.

A `switch` statement inside a function is still reported when that
function is written inside another `switch` statement.

## Examples

### Invalid

```js
function foo(n, m) {
    switch (n) {
        case 0:
            switch (m) {
                case 1:
                    break;
            }
            break;
        default:
            break;
    }
}
```

```js
switch (n) {
    case 0: {
        const handle = (m) => {
            switch (m) {
                case 1:
                    break;
            }
        };
        handle(n);
        break;
    }
}
```

### Valid

```js
function foo(n, m) {
    switch (n) {
        case 0:
            bar(m);
            break;
        default:
            break;
    }
}

function bar(m) {
    switch (m) {
        case 1:
            break;
    }
}
```
